studies.title: Niagara Falls
studies.caption: Green water rolls over the curved ledge of Horseshoe Falls and disappears into rising mist.
studies.prompt: Oblique view from a wooded upstream bank of Niagara's Horseshoe Falls, powerful green water curling over a broad curved limestone ledge, foaming drop into misty river below, low flat forested horizon. Before modern development; no towers, roads, railings or boats.
